title: 电影发行年份
problem_statement_md:
给定程序，它应该输出一部著名电影的名字和发行年份。

但该程序有错误。请修改代码以获得正确的输出。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Introduction to data types[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 
You are given a program that should output the name and the release year of a famous movie.
But the program has errors. Fix the code to get the correct output.

[note]Pay attention to the variables data types and their values.[/note]
hint_md: 注意变量的数据类型和它们的值。
